tagline: SkiFree on a phone: tilt to steer, race a friend's ghost.
description:
Send the Invite in the bar above the slope. A friend opens the link and you both ski your own run — they show up as a ghost, a little ahead or a little behind. Farthest down the mountain wins.

On your own it is SkiFree. Point where you want to go — mouse, keys, a finger, or tilt the phone — and you go. Trees, rocks, jumps. Crash and get back up. Go far enough and something hungry starts hunting you. Five skiers; when they are gone, that is how far you got. Next run, a ghost of your best skis with you.

On a phone you drag on the snow, tilt to steer, and tap BOOST to go faster.

Your best distance is saved.

An unofficial port of SkiFree.js by basicallydan, MIT-licensed. The pictures come from the 1991 PC game. This copy adds the ghosts and the phone. Bugs go to GifOS, not upstream.
